source_snapshot.procedure: Synchronized AMD-SMI 5 s, AGT 50 ms, Redfish system telemetry, >=1 min idle, eight-GPU Coralgemm for 40 min, >=1 min post-idle, common-axis analysis.
source_snapshot.criteria: No hang/reset, no GPU overheat/offline, review dmesg throttling and reach Power Cap.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek reduces the case to rocm-smi temperature observation and omits the eight-GPU workload, synchronized telemetry, duration, power-cap, process completion and system criteria.

original_test_intent.purpose: Thermally load all eight mapped AMD GPUs with the specified Coralgemm DGEMM workload for 40 minutes while synchronously measuring GPU, system cooling and PSU behavior, then verify power-cap attainment without overheat, offline GPU, hang, unintended reset or disqualifying throttle/error.
original_test_intent.target: The eight owner-mapped AMD GPU devices represented by ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES 0-7 and the corresponding AGT device/AID identifiers, together with system inlet, fans and PSU telemetry on one dedicated SUT.
original_test_intent.scope: Minimum one-minute stabilized pre-idle, one controlled 40-minute concurrent eight-GPU workload, minimum one-minute post-idle, continuous AMD-SMI/AGT/Redfish/system logs and common-time-axis analysis. It is not a temperature query or a single-GPU test.
original_test_intent.operation: Validate identities/mappings/tools/limits, start time-synchronized monitors, establish the idle signature, launch and supervise eight exact gemm processes as one bounded group, continuously enforce stop thresholds, record GFLOP/power/temp/clock/XGMI/fan/PSU evidence, terminate/collect all processes, observe post-idle recovery and correlate logs.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One 40-minute workload interval (`2400` seconds in each source command) bracketed by at least one minute of stable idle on each side; extend/restart the pre-idle only if fan/thermal stabilization is not reached under owner rules.
original_test_intent.expected_result: All eight workloads run for the intended window with valid GFLOP records; every GPU remains online and within approved thermal limits; no hang/unintended reset/new hardware error occurs; required power-cap behavior is demonstrated; throttle evidence is absent or within the owner policy; cooling/PSU behavior and post-idle recovery are acceptable.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Exact GPU UUID/BDF/ROCR/AGT mapping and versions; thresholds/power caps; pre/post idle state; full AMD-SMI, AGT, Redfish and system streams; eight process PIDs/commands/stdout/stderr/start/end/exit; GFLOPs; event/reset/offline/throttle/RAS evidence; synchronized plots; recovery/final state.
ambiguities: The relation between AGT indices `0,5,...35` and ROCR device IDs `0..7` is not defined.
GPU-specific thermal, power-cap and acceptable-throttling thresholds are absent.
The exact Coralgemm/AGT versions and `-clkrestore` behavior are absent.
The required stabilization criterion beyond fan-speed decrease is qualitative.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 accurately restores the full eight-GPU, 40-minute synchronized thermal soak, process-group completion, power/cooling evidence, strict stops and no-log-clear rule. It requires mapping generally but does not make the source's two incompatible-looking identifier sets an explicit go/no-go mapping table.

applicable_history.decision: V2 correctly rejects the historical rocm-smi-only shortcut and classifies the complete high-risk workload as REQUIRES. No later user ruling supplies GPU limits or AGT/ROCR mapping.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2's class and 40-minute all-GPU intent. Add an explicit UUID/BDF/ROCR/AGT mapping gate, current AMD-SMI semantics, quantitative stabilization/stop rules and a completion condition requiring every background process and monitor to be accounted for.

available_now: The workload commands, eight ROCR-visible targets, 2400-second duration, telemetry classes, sampling periods and high-level acceptance are explicit.
Read-only inventory, package/version checks, baseline health and candidate mapping can be collected before load approval.
missing_inputs: The AMD/platform owner must supply exact GPU UUID/BDF-to-ROCR 0-7-to-AGT 0,5,...35 mapping and tool/version compatibility.
The SI owner must supply per-GPU power cap, thermal and throttle rules, stabilization tolerance, fan/PSU limits, acceptable GFLOP behavior and error policy.
The lab owner must provide dedicated-SUT/cooling/power readiness, protected Redfish, maintenance approval, emergency stop and recovery.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The AMD/platform owner supplies device/tool mapping; the SI/performance owner supplies acceptance/stop thresholds; the lab owner supplies infrastructure and authorization.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect GPU UUID/BDF/partition/topology, AMD-SMI/AGT/ROCm/driver/firmware versions and idle telemetry/logs without loading GPUs.
Validate output storage, clocks, Redfish resource identity and process supervisor in a no-load dry run without clearing logs.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not infer AGT-to-ROCR identity, load a partial/wrong GPU set, modprobe/change driver unexpectedly, clear logs, use unbounded background shells, run without cooling/power/stop limits, continue after monitoring loss or automatically rerun a fault.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Sign off the eight-way mapping and thresholds, prove synchronized monitors/storage and emergency stop, approve the dedicated window, account for all eight processes and monitors for the full 40 minutes, correlate all evidence, confirm final idle/online state and preserve anomalies.

revision_candidate.test_name: Eight-GPU AMD Thermal and Power-Cap Soak with Coralgemm
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the specified 40-minute Coralgemm workload on all eight mapped AMD GPUs with synchronized GPU/system telemetry and verify power-cap, thermal, stability and recovery criteria.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact AMD eight-GPU/OAM server, ROCm/amdgpu/AMD-SMI/AGT/Coralgemm and BMC Redfish versions approved by the platform recipe, on a dedicated cooled and power-qualified SUT.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Eight exact GPU UUIDs/BDFs mapped to ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES 0-7 and the eight AGT identifiers, plus inlet/fan/PSU/system health. One pre-idle, one 40-minute run and one post-idle.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Immutable eight-way mapping; tool/binary versions and hashes; source workload parameters; per-GPU power/thermal/throttle limits; GFLOP rules; stabilization/stop policy; Redfish resource map/credentials; time sync/storage; cooling/power readiness; approval; emergency stop/recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify mapping and start bounded AMD-SMI 5-second, AGT 50-ms, Redfish and system monitors with unique outputs. Establish at least one minute of owner-defined stable idle. Launch the eight exact gemm commands under a supervisor that records every PID and status for 2400 seconds while enforcing stops. Record at least one minute post-idle, stop all monitors cleanly and correlate raw streams/plots on one time axis.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT and eight GPUs online; no competing load; tools/driver/firmware compatible; limits/mapping approved; adequate cooling/PSU and storage; clocks synchronized; monitors validated; console/emergency recovery ready; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version/hash and eight-way map; thresholds/approval; pre/post idle; full AMD-SMI, AGT and Redfish streams; eight command/PID/start/end/exit/GFLOP logs; system/RAS/dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL; common-axis power/temp/GFXCLK/GFLOP/fan/PSU plots; power-cap/throttle analysis; online/final recovery state.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved AMD platform thermal/power recipe for the exact tool and GPU versions plus source duration and criteria: no hang/reset/overheat/offline, reviewed throttling, all-GPU workload completion and demonstrated approved power-cap behavior.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Dedicated SUT only. Do not guess device mapping/limits, clear logs, expose secrets, run with competing load, leave orphan workloads/monitors, suppress errors, exceed cooling/power stops, continue after telemetry loss or blindly rerun an unexplained failure.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Explicit approval is required for the eight-GPU 40-minute load, exact limits/power cap, cooling/power readiness, maintenance window and recovery. Read-only preparation alone does not authorize load.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Automation can supervise workload/telemetry and evaluate supplied rules. The platform/lab engineer certifies physical cooling/power readiness, mappings/limits and final interpretation of throttling and recovery.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On a stop condition, terminate the controlled process group, preserve all partial streams and current state, use the independent console/lab recovery plan and do not rerun until the owner explains the event and reauthorizes.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Mapping/tool/version mismatch; any missing GPU or monitor; storage/time-sync failure; inadequate idle stabilization; thermal/power/fan/PSU limit; unexpected throttle policy breach; GPU offline/loss; hang/reset; new XGMI/ECC/AER/RAS/driver/BMC error; workload exit/performance anomaly; orphan process; or failed post-idle recovery.

identified_defects: DeepSeek replaces the complete thermal soak with a temperature query.
DeepSeek uses deprecated rocm-smi/unsafe SSH and omits all system telemetry/process evidence.
The source does not map AGT identifiers to ROCR devices or give quantitative thermal/power/throttle/stabilization limits.
The shell layout backgrounds seven jobs and requires explicit whole-group supervision.
reason_for_change: Ensure the workload and telemetry truly cover the same eight physical GPUs and that completion cannot be claimed from one foreground process, one temperature stream or an uncorrelated partial log.

new_technical_evidence.title: AMD SMI CLI tool usage
new_technical_evidence.applicability: AMD-SMI monitoring, constrained by the approved version on the SUT
new_technical_evidence.supports: `amd-smi monitor` supports watch interval/time/iterations, GPU selection by ID/BDF/UUID and power, temperature, clock/utilization and error-related telemetry; AMD-SMI replaces/deprecates rocm_smi.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The target-approved AMD-SMI version, exact output fields and partition mapping are not supplied.

removed_ambiguities: Requires an explicit cross-tool identity map instead of assuming index equivalence.
Defines all eight background jobs and all monitors as required completion units.
Turns qualitative idle/power/throttle language into owner-supplied measurable gates.
resolved_blockers: Read-only inventory and monitor dry-run preparation can proceed before load approval.
remaining_blockers: The eight-way map, compatible proprietary tools, quantitative limits and dedicated-SUT load approval/recovery remain required.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 keeps V2's complete high-risk workflow but closes the cross-tool device-identity and process-accounting gaps that could silently leave GPUs untested or logs misattributed.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator recovered the eight exact mapped GPUs, >=1-minute pre/post idle, eight supervised 2400-second processes, synchronized AMD-SMI/AGT/Redfish/system evidence, authorization, quantitative stops and recovery. It rejected numeric index equivalence, launch-only completion, monitor gaps, guessed limits, broad process kills and blind rerun. Missing mappings/rules/infrastructure are PLATFORM_HANDOFF_DEFECT; unsafe invention would be MODEL_PLANNING_ERROR.
